page.overview:
Who is Rio Haryanto?

Rio Haryanto (born 22 January 1993) is an Indonesian Formula One driver who formerly drove for . He is Indonesia's first F1 driver. He raced in the first twelve races of the 2016 season, but after having a lack of sponsorship money, Manor put him under the role of a reserve driver, while his racing seat was taken by 's reserve driver Esteban Ocon starting from the .
